en-US.title: Deckhead
en-US.subtitle: Charades Party Game
en-US.promoText: Phone on your forehead. Friends shout clues. Every deck free, no ads, no accounts — and make your own decks in seconds.
en-US.description:
Hold the phone to your forehead. A word appears that everyone can see except you. Your friends shout clues, act it out, hum it — anything but say the word — and you guess as many as you can before the timer runs out.

EVERYTHING IS FREE
Every deck is included from the moment you install. No ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no accounts.

MAKE YOUR OWN DECKS
Inside jokes, your friends' names, your office legends. Type a few cards or paste a whole list at once.

SHARE IN SECONDS
Show a QR code and the whole room has your deck. Or send it as a link or a file — it travels inside the code, so nothing is uploaded anywhere.

CONTROLS YOU CAN TRUST
Tap the top half of the screen if you got it, the bottom half to pass. Huge targets you can hit without looking. Prefer tilting? Turn it on in Settings — it's built to ignore an excited jerk of the phone.

A GAME WITH AN ENDING
Play in teams or just play together. Pick a number of rounds, a target score, or play until the cards run out. Deckhead rotates who holds the phone, keeps the score, and lets you fix a mis-tap after every round.

BUILT FOR A ROOM AFTER DARK
Giant, bold cards that fill the screen. Full-screen flashes everyone can read from across the room. Buzzes that tell the holder what happened without leaking it to the guesser.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Deckhead works completely offline and collects nothing. Your decks and games stay on your phone.
en-US.releaseNotes: Meet Dex! A brand-new look, a quick how-to-play, tilt controls, and a whole lot more bounce.
